name: Gheorghe Popescu
bio: Gheorghe's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with Lada engines in his father's garage in Bucharest. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering and soon found himself applying his skills to rallying, working with a local team optimizing car performance for the challenging Transfăgărășan Highway. He is a firm believer in data-driven decisions, meticulously analyzing telemetry to identify areas for improvement. His calm and methodical approach has earned him the respect of drivers and mechanics alike, making him a reliable and steady presence in any team.

physical.description: A man of average height with a slightly weathered face, hinting at years spent trackside.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten calculations.
Insists on using a slide rule alongside modern software for cross-checking.
Has a particular fondness for strong Romanian coffee, which he brews himself in the paddock.
